footnote_text: Pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of July 28, 2026, by and among the Issuer, Viking ParentCo, Inc., ("Parent"), and Viking MergerCo, Inc. ("Merger Sub"), Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer, with the Issuer continuing as the surviving corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. || Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the merger (the "Effective Time"), each outstanding share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of the Issuer was canceled and converted into the right to receive $55.00 in cash per share, without interest ("Merger Consideration"). || At the Effective Time, each unvested RSU held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into a replacement cash-settled RSU award representing the right to receive $55.00 in cash for each underlying share, subject to the same vesting schedule and substantially the same terms and conditions applicable to the corresponding RSU immediately prior to the Effective Time.
